verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own docs say any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client (Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail) can connect to an AgentMail inbox, so mail stays reachable over open protocols. The pack has nothing on JMAP or on exporting mail in standard formats (mbox/EML), and only a single doc line backs the IMAP/SMTP claim. missing for 10: JMAP access, standards-based export (mbox/EML), detailed IMAP/SMTP docs (limits, auth, sync behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in

citations.quote: Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to your AgentMail inbox
